title: Open-source renderer and CAD-app route screen
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan update
scope: Screen open-source CAD application and rendering routes beyond codec libraries
Trace each route to its underlying DWG/DXF codec lineage
Separate 2D projection and ACIS tessellation claims from document and solid semantics
Reconcile peer consumer claims with existing PAR-49 paper-space and PAR-07/S8 gates

sources.observation: The README identifies an ACadRust parse adapter followed by a separate renderer/indexer. It reports 11 real AC1032 drawings and 23 pages, but does not bind the corpus or outputs to hashes. It lists multiple unrendered families, including ACIS solids, and uses fit points/control polygon rather than De Boor evaluation for splines.
sources.planDisposition: Optional AC1032 2D projection diagnostic only, deduplicated under ACadRust parser lineage. Any future use must pin source/build/input and report per-layout/page, per-entity rendered/unsupported/failed/unmatched disposition. No writer, spline-semantic, or ACIS claim follows.

sources.observation: The README describes .NET 10, an ACadSharp-backed IO layer, a distinct render-scene pipeline, Trace CLI, and test projects; it advertises ACIS SAT/SAB rendering but supplies no exact release/source-to-binary binding or per-body validity evidence in the reviewed overview.
sources.planDisposition: Possible application-level projection observer under ACadSharp lineage, not an extra codec vote or ACIS semantic oracle. Require exact build/input profile, parse and render dispositions, and independent geometry expectations before use.

sources.observation: The current README advertises native DWG/DXF read/write targets from R14 through 2018, ACIS entity tessellation, and desktop releases for Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon macOS. Release notes mention codec/kernel updates, but this pass did not bind an exact binary to source/lock revisions or per-entity results. The already-reviewed file-codec lineage is ACadRust.
sources.planDisposition: Refresh application route declaration only. Deduplicate codec evidence under ACadRust; keep rendering/kernel observations distinct and optional. Exact artifact, embedded codec/kernel revisions, platform, source/output identity, and loss diagnostics are prerequisites.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8 distinguishes app rendering/tessellation from typed parsing, carrier preservation, and ACIS solid validity
PAR-07/S8 groups application observations under the actual underlying codec lineage
PAR-49 retains the generated AC1015 legacy chain as the fast owner while marking full table/LAYOUT decode and producer interoperability unqualified

limitations: Repository READMEs and release notes are mutable project-authored claims. No package, source archive, drawing, renderer, desktop application, or geometry kernel was downloaded or executed. The dwg2png corpus identities and ProCad per-body acceptance are not established by the reviewed pages. No new local implementation behavior is inferred.
